affected_boundaries: persisted rebase analysis and run state

observed_behavior: Semantic rebase analysis rejected an authorized native worker checkout with detached HEAD.
expected_behavior: Freeze and replay the exact detached source commit without requiring a branch or moving an existing branch.
causal_mechanism: Source discovery treated symbolic-ref exit status 1 as an error, although it denotes the valid detached HEAD state; persisted sourceBranch also required a string.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Represent every valid source checkout as a symbolic branch.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Native worker checkouts may be detached, so analysis fails before reviewing their changes.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Freeze source commit and attachment state independently and reject changes to either before replay.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Represent detached sourceBranch as null in V2, distinguish symbolic-ref detached status from actual failure, and preserve V1 readers and original digest bindings.

applicability_conditions: A clean authorized source checkout has detached HEAD and commits to replay.
known_non_matches: An attached source branch already passed discovery.
confirmation_evidence: A disposable detached fixture reproduced the symbolic-ref failure before repair; focused regression cases now exercise detached replay and retained V1 state.
regression_proofs: tests/semantic-rebase.test.ts: detached source replays without attaching or moving the original branch
tests/semantic-rebase.test.ts: detached selected replay supports continue and abort
tests/semantic-rebase.test.ts: source attachment change after review is rejected
tests/semantic-rebase.test.ts: retained V1 analysis and run state resume without changing their digest binding
